name: held
note: A press that never moves keeps its dot, at full size and opacity.

name: line
note: A fast straight line, released at 0.4 seconds: the tail retreats, then the rest fades.

name: circle
note: A blue circle and a bit more, so the trail crosses itself, still held.

name: rest
note: The pointer rests longer than the lifetime, then moves on: the old part stays gone.

name: two strokes
note: A second press starts a new stroke with its own color and width.

name: tiny steps
note: Moves closer than minimumStep to the point before the newest move the newest point.
